searchText: MSRP $319,515 The New 2026 Thor Motor Coach Palazzo GT Diesel Pusher Model 33.5 Bunk House Optional Features Stealth Package Leatherette Power Reclining Theater Seats Frameless Dual Pane Windows 500W Solar Charging System  This RV features a power drop down loft, 100-watt solar charging system, 300 HP Cummins diesel engine with 660 lbs. of torque and a Freightliner XC chassis.
